COMPARE · JWERO VS JEWELACC

Jwero vs JewelAcc

JewelAcc is an ERP for jewellery manufacturers and distributors covering inventory, production, sales/purchase, billing and accounting, with pre-built hardware integrations (scales, barcode scanners, RFID). Here is where it genuinely wins, where Jwero is built differently, and what we haven’t independently verified, marked plainly rather than asserted.

QUESTIONS SWITCHERS ASK

Questions about switching from JewelAcc.

Jwero or JewelAcc: which should a jeweller choose?

Choose JewelAcc if you want a manufacturer/distributor-focused ERP with hardware pre-integration already solved, jewellery scales, barcode printers and scanners, RFID, plus a genuine free trial to test before buying. Choose Jwero if accounting and production tracking are only part of the job, you also want customer memory, WhatsApp/Instagram selling and a governed AI workforce sharing one record with the books.

Does Jwero do jewellery-specific accounting like JewelAcc?

Jwero bridges to Tally and Zoho Books for statutory accounting rather than replacing an accounting-first tool. If hardware-integrated production and accounting depth is your primary need, JewelAcc may be the right fit for that layer, Jwero adds the customer and channel side around it.

Can I trial JewelAcc before switching?

JewelAcc states a trial option is available, ask them directly for current terms. Jwero’s equivalent is a supervised pilot using your own real customer data.

Can I move my data from JewelAcc to Jwero?

Customers, products and stock are imported for you from exports or spreadsheets, and the history you need is brought across. The Migration Centre lists what moves and how.

How long does switching from JewelAcc take?

Set-up takes a day, and most businesses settle in within thirty days. Avoid switching in your busiest season; start before it or after it.

Can I run JewelAcc and Jwero side by side for a while?

Yes. Many jewellers start with one function in Jwero, such as WhatsApp or customers, while the old system keeps running, then move the rest when they are ready.
